h1: Sunee Boutique Hotel Uttaradit — a green-garden boutique in town, quiet, with plenty of parking
intro: If you want to stay in central Uttaradit but not in a packed concrete block — somewhere small, with a garden, real trees, and a quiet night's sleep — Sunee Boutique Hotel is the name guests in this part of town keep mentioning. It's a 3-star boutique hotel with 35 rooms on Boromat Road, Soi 3, in Tha It, just a short walk from Klong Pho Market. Rooms come with private balconies, the owner tends the garden personally so it stays green and tidy, and prices start at about ฿600/night including breakfast.

body.html: What sets Sunee Boutique Hotel apart from the usual in-town Uttaradit options is the garden. The hotel is a low-rise building wrapped around a green space that the owner keeps personally; several reviews single out the neatly trimmed lawn and trees, which make the whole place feel leafier and calmer than the taller hotels in the centre. It's the kind of place meant for an actual rest, not just a bed to crash in.

The location sits on Boromat Road, Soi 3, in Tha It — about 600 metres' walk to Klong Pho Market, the local go-to for street food in Uttaradit. The Uttaradit Clock Tower is roughly 1.3 km away and the railway station about 1.5 km, both only a few minutes by car; the town centre is about 900 metres off. Driving here is easy thanks to a free, wide car park with several entrances and exits — a point reviewers mention often.

There are 35 rooms across Standard Queen, Deluxe Queen and Standard Twin categories, each around 18 sq.m. Every room has a private balcony, a refrigerator, an LED TV, air conditioning and strong hot water, and many Deluxe rooms add a bathtub. Guests say the rooms are roomier than expected, the beds comfortable, and the Wi-Fi reliable throughout. The balcony looking onto the garden is the detail most people say they liked best.
"Clean room, strong water pressure, good Wi-Fi signal, a wide car park with several ways in and out, and friendly, helpful staff. Quiet and stress-free overall — great value for the price."

To be straight with you, cleanliness isn't consistent across every room. Some reviews mention stained towels, dust in corners, or rooms that don't quite match the listing photos, and a few furnishings are starting to show their age. The other thing to know is that there's no on-site restaurant — only breakfast is served, so other meals mean heading out. That's no real hardship, though, since Klong Pho Market and the town's eateries are close by.

One noise note worth knowing before you book: some guests report sound from a nearby football field at certain times. Staff can also be slow to respond on occasion, so if you have a special request it's worth calling ahead to confirm. That said, most real guests describe the staff as warm and good at recommending where to eat and what to see around town.

Overall, Sunee Boutique Hotel scores around 7.2–7.6 out of 10 on the booking platforms and 4.0 out of 5 on TripAdvisor, ranking near the top among boutique and guesthouse stays in Uttaradit town. It's no luxury property, but measured on its green garden, the quiet, the balcony rooms, the generous parking and a starting rate of around ฿600 — climbing into the low thousands by season and room type — it's a well-judged pick for anyone who wants a calm, restful stay in the centre.

A tip drawn from the reviews: ask for a Deluxe room with a balcony facing the garden, and if you're noise-sensitive, request a room on the side farther from the football field. Check the room's condition at check-in — if any linen or corner isn't clean, ask the staff to swap it. Arriving by train, it's just a few minutes by car from the station.

honestSummary: Sunee Boutique Hotel is a well-judged pick for anyone who wants a quiet, garden stay in central Uttaradit — leafy surroundings, balcony rooms, a wide car park and free breakfast, all in the few-hundred to low-thousand baht range. The trade-offs are cleanliness that isn't consistent in every room and no on-site restaurant.
honestChecks: If you're very particular about cleanliness — some rooms have reviews about stained linen or dusty corners → check the room at check-in and ask for a swap or fresh linen if it isn't right.
If you want a hotel with its own restaurant — only breakfast is served here, with no dining room for other meals → plan to eat at Klong Pho Market or the nearby town eateries.
If you're noise-sensitive and a light sleeper — there's occasional sound from a nearby football field → ask for a room on the far side and pick one facing the garden, which is quieter.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Sunee Boutique Hotel Uttaradit

faq.q: Where is Sunee Boutique Hotel in Uttaradit, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Sunee Boutique Hotel is at 68/6 Boromat Road, Soi 3, Tha It, in central Uttaradit. It's about 600 metres' walk to Klong Pho Market, roughly 1.3 km from the Uttaradit Clock Tower and about 1.5 km from the railway station — only a few minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Sunee Boutique Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿600/night for a Standard Queen, breakfast included. Options run from Standard Queen and Standard Twin up to the Deluxe Queen with a bathtub, and every room has a private balcony. Rates rise by season and room type into the low thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Sunee Boutique Hotel have parking?
faq.a: Yes. Free parking with a wide car park and several entrances and exits — a point real reviews praise often. It's well suited to guests arriving by car.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Sunee Boutique Hotel — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are about 18 sq.m, each with a private balcony, fridge, LED TV, strong hot water and good Wi-Fi. That said, cleanliness isn't consistent across every room — some reviews mention stained linen or dusty corners. Check the room at check-in and ask for a swap if it isn't right.

faq.q: Does Sunee Boutique Hotel have a restaurant?
faq.a: The hotel serves free breakfast but has no on-site restaurant for other meals. Lunch and dinner mean heading out, which is easy since Klong Pho Market is about 600 metres away on foot.

faq.q: Who is Sunee Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for anyone wanting a quiet, garden stay in central Uttaradit — couples, families or guests driving in who value leafy surroundings and parking. It isn't about luxury, but it's well-judged for a restful night or two on a comfortable budget.
